SWPCGIRDER_DLG.description: Pre/Post-Tensioned Composite Girder Bridge Wizard Dialog (SWPCGIRDER_DLG). Either opens the wizard dialog or loads a .wzd/.wiz file into an already-open dialog, driven by which Argument field is set.

Argument.description: Request body. Set OPEN_DIALOG=true to launch the wizard dialog, OR set OPEN_PATH to a non-empty file path to load a file into an already-open dialog. Setting both true/non-empty at once is rejected by the handler.

OPEN_DIALOG.description: When true, launches the Pre/Post-Tensioned Composite Girder Bridge Wizard dialog. Must not be true together with a non-empty OPEN_PATH (handler throws).

OPEN_PATH.description: [OPEN_DIALOG=false] .wiz file open path. When non-empty, sends the file path (WM_COPYDATA) to the already-open wizard dialog; the dialog must already be open or the handler throws. Must not be combined with OPEN_DIALOG=true.
